definition: to visit the famous places of a city
description: A laughing young couple ride one red bicycle across a large cobbled square in the evening, in front of a grand baroque church with two bell towers lit by string lights. A young man in a green T-shirt pedals and looks up at the church, while a young woman sits behind him and looks up too. They ride towards the camera as a pigeon flies off, past a dropped ice cream cone lying on the cobbles. A street painter with an easel, a horse and carriage, tourists and cafe tables with umbrellas fill the square.

en.question: What are the man and woman doing?

de.answer: Sie machen mit dem Fahrrad eine Besichtigungstour.
de.question: Was machen der Mann und die Frau?

es.question: ¿Qué están haciendo el hombre y la mujer?

fr.answer: Ils visitent la ville à vélo.
